strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.
The balance sheet is effectively debt-free.
The DCF puts intrinsic value well above the market price.

Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.

The net profit trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.

strengths.point: The reserves trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.

Costs are rising faster than sales.
Inventory tie up a lot of cash.
Working capital absorbs a very large slice of the year's sales.
Institutional money has been flowing out.

opportunities.point: Management stated that the 22 new stores are being funded with the IPO money.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Yes, it is with the IPO money, ma'am." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that the Indian consumer is maturing into wanting branded products, good quality research products, and brand association at the right price.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "I feel that the Indian consumer is now maturing into wanting branded product, wanting to have an experience of good quality researched product, and wanting to be associated with the brand at the right price." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that products are available to consumers through marketplace channels in roughly 20,000 plus PIN codes.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Through marketplace channels, roughly 20,000 plus PIN codes, our products are available to consumers, where we are in partnership with Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Tata CLiQ Luxury, Flipkart, Amazon, and everybody." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated an aspiration to open 50 stores of Sneaker in the next 5 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Yeah, we aspire to have 50 stores of Sneaker in the next 5 years." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 5 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated a target to make the company a 500 crore business company.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Now we are all focusing on how to make it a ₹500 Cr business company." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that retail and e-commerce gross margins are around 50 to 54% or 54% plus, while B2B gross margins are around 50%.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "We have retail and e-commerce with gross margins of around 50 to 54%. B2B margins are slightly lower on gross margin part, as they go to wholesalers and export suppliers." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that in FY26, the advertisement cost in comparison to revenue is around 5 to 6% only.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "in FY26, our advertisement cost in comparison to revenue is around 5 to 6% only." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 21 -> 25 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -1 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -39 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management stated that On Running is still looking to get the BIS approved and the approval is pending.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "It is pending for On Running. It is still pending for On Running. On Running is still looking to get the BIS approved." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
